title: The Resonance of Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to grasp the full meaning of that testament, a sigh echoed from the depths of the cosmos. Chen Tianming's face twisted within the light screen—the Heavenly Eye had awakened.

text.content: The turtle shell artifact's light acted like an invisible thread, pulling Chen Ji's consciousness toward the unknown star region in the north. He sat cross-legged, forming seals with both hands, as the Tianji Record Fragment manifested faint golden patterns at his brow center. Candlelight flickered in the cultivation room, illuminating his resolute profile. The clues buried ten years ago would finally reveal their final secret today.

dialogue.content: "You have finally arrived." An ancient and majestic voice emerged from the depths of the turtle shell. The light screen before Chen Ji shifted dramatically as countless stars rotated and arranged around him, eventually converging into a vague humanoid form—it was Cang Huangtian's remnant soul projection.

text.content: Within the light screen, Cang Huangtian's form grew increasingly distinct. Chaotic energy currents swirled around him, his deep eyes like an abyss, as if observing the primordial scene of all creation. Chen Ji sensed an indescribable pressure emanating from the light screen—a remnant of cosmic will that transcended mortal comprehension.

dialogue.content: "Your mother Chen Xuan was no ordinary woman." Cang Huangtian's voice reverberated through the cultivation room, each word striking Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. "She was a vessel chosen by cosmic will—a 'Dao Embryo' bearing the laws of all creation. Her very existence is the key to maintaining balance across the Three Thousand Worlds."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind buzzing, as if countless thunderclaps had exploded simultaneously. His hands unconsciously clenched into fists, knuckles whitening from the force. His mother—that gentle woman who mended his clothes for him—was actually an embodiment of cosmic-level existence? He had imagined her true identity countless times, yet had never conceived of this possibility.

dialogue.content: "That's impossible!" Chen Ji abruptly stood up, his voice trembling slightly from agitation. "My mother was just an ordinary mortal woman. She embroidered and wove cloth in Chen Family Village, she—" His words halted abruptly, because he suddenly recalled the look in his mother's eyes before she died—that gaze that seemed capable of seeing through fate itself.

text.content: Cang Huangtian waved his hand, and an ancient scene appeared in the light screen. It was a chaotic void, countless points of light drifting like fireflies, and at the very center of the void stood a figure quietly—Cang Huangtian projected the image of Chen Xuan in her youth, surrounded by brilliant golden light, exactly like the current Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "The 'Dao Embryo' must undergo the suffering of reincarnation, shedding its divinity to become mortal." Cang Huangtian's voice carried a hint of emotion. "Chen Xuan chose to hide in Chen Family Village precisely to allow you—her blood-bearing child—to gain complete humanity. But the Heavenly Dao laws changed, and she was forced to fall before completing her mission."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, as if something was awakening deep within his bloodline. He looked down at his hands to see golden patterns faintly emerging beneath his skin, like the lingering warmth his mother left when she stroked his forehead. That was the resonance of bloodline—a connection between him and Chen Xuan that transcended life and death.

dialogue.content: "The Chen Family bloodline was no coincidence." Cang Huangtian's form began to fade. "In ancient times, there existed beings who attempted to break the cosmic cycle of order. They created the 'Heavenly Fate Bloodline' experiment—dispersing the power of the 'Dao Embryo' into mortal bloodlines, passing it down through generations, waiting for one person to awaken. Both you and Chen Nian are products of this experiment."

text.content: Countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning. The massacre at Chen Family Village, his father's mysterious disappearance, his sister being taken by the Holy Sect—all tragedies pointed to one terrible truth—they were merely pieces on someone else's chessboard. And his mother Chen Xuan had perhaps known all of this long ago.

choice.prompt: Faced with the impact of bloodline truth, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Accept his mother's unfinished mission, bearing the responsibility of maintaining cosmic balance as the Son of the Dao Embryo.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Possibility of an Ordinary Life
choices.visible_reward: Gain recognition from the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Conflict between mission and the Heavenly Eye is inevitable

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. He felt the power surging within his bloodline—that was his mother's final gift to him. "I understand." His voice was low and firm. "Since this was Mother's choice, it is also my path."

choices.memory_label: 选择了继承母亲的使命

choices.description: Without rushing to make a decision, demand Cang Huangtian reveal more secrets about the Heavenly Fate Bloodline experiment and the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Gain more intelligence about the enemy
choices.risk_hint: The truth is often crueler than imagination

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately agree; instead, he gazed sharply at Cang Huangtian's figure within the light screen. "Before I decide, I need to know more." His voice was calm and restrained. "Who exactly were those beings who created the Heavenly Fate Bloodline experiment? And what is the Heavenly Eye?"

choices.description: Regardless of the bloodline truth, what Chen Ji thought of first was his missing sister Chen Nian—she was also part of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline experiment.
choices.visible_reward: Strengthen the bond with Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's pursuers could appear at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly softened, and his mind was filled with his sister's innocent smile. "Chen Nian..." he murmured. "If I am a product of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline experiment, then so is she. Did they take her because there is something more important on her than on me?"

At that moment, the bloodline power dormant within Chen Ji for years was like a awakened beast, suddenly erupting with brilliant golden light. He let out a painful groan, kneeling on one knee, both hands clutching his chest tightly. That light burst forth from his heart, transforming into countless tiny points that formed a massive star map within the cultivation room.

dialogue.content: "This is..." Cang Huangtian's remnant soul projection trembled violently, his eyes showing shock for the first time. "Bloodline resonance! The connection between you and Chen Xuan runs deeper than this old man anticipated. Though she has perished, her remnant will has always been guarding you within—waiting for this moment."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a warm force rising from the depths of his bloodline, like his mother's hand gently stroking his cheek. That was Chen Xuan's remnant will—gentle, firm, full of sacrifice. Tears unconsciously slid down his cheeks. How many years had it been since he last cried? At this moment, he seemed to return to his childhood, to those nights nestled in his mother's embrace.

dialogue.content: "Mother..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, carrying suppressed longing and guilt accumulated over many years. "I'm sorry, I couldn't protect Chen Nian... I'm sorry, I disappointed your expectations..." For the first time, he showed such a vulnerable side before others—the hardships of pretending to be atrash for years, the loneliness of bearing everything alone, all pouring out at this moment.

text.content: The star map formed by bloodline resonance suddenly contracted, turning into a streak of golden light that merged into Chen Ji's brow center. He felt his mind explode as countless scenes flashed by like a carousel—his mother's smiling face, his father's departing silhouette, young Chen Nian's laughter chasing butterflies in the courtyard... and a testament sealed deep within his bloodline.

choice.prompt: The testament call from the depths of the bloodline—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Completely open his heart and mind to welcome his mother's final testament and memories, even if this might shake his will.
choices.visible_cost: May lose himself in his mother's memories
choices.visible_reward: Completely receive his mother's full will inheritance
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may seize the opportunity to invade

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing that warm force to envelop him. He no longer resisted, no longer feared. His mother's will flowed into his Mental Sea like a tide, containing tenderness, expectation, reluctance... and words spanning life and death.

choices.description: Carefully open a crack, receiving his mother's testament while remaining vigilant to prevent accidents.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Huangtian may be watching from the side

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, using the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium to construct a protective barrier within his Mental Sea. He allowed his mother's will to flow in, but maintained a final thread of clarity. The warm force entered his consciousness like a gentle stream,不至于冲垮他的心神防线。

Just as Chen Ji struggled to receive the residual memories in his bloodline, the night sky outside the cultivation room suddenly turned pitch black. An overwhelming pressure descended from beyond the nine heavens, the roof of the cultivation room shattering with a thunderous crash, turning into countless dust particles. A massive vertical eye slowly opened in the void, gazing indifferently at this land.

dialogue.content: Cang Huangtian's remnant soul projection trembled violently, his voice carrying unprecedented terror: "Not good! It's the Heavenly Eye's本体! It sensed the bloodline resonance's aura and is tracking it!" His figure began to dissipate rapidly. "Chen Ji, run! It cannot discover you are still alive—"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head. That vertical eye's pressure pressed down on him like a mountain, nearly suffocating him. But he did not retreat; instead, he stepped forward, his eyes burning with determination. He had lost too much—lost his father, lost his mother, lost his peaceful life. Now, even his sister had been taken away. What did he have left to lose?

dialogue.content: "Run?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, his voice echoing through the night sky. "My mother sacrificed everything for this world, my sister was taken as a piece and imprisoned for years, I endured twenty years of my 'trash' persona..." He took a deep breath, the golden light within his body forming a standoff with that vertical eye's pressure. "Today, let's see what this so-called Heavenly Dao can do to me!"

text.content: At that moment, a gentle yet firm voice came from the depths of Chen Ji's bloodline—that was the final echo of his mother Chen Xuan's remnant will: "Child... find your sister... she is the key to everything... don't let Mother's tragedy repeat..." The voice grew fainter, like a dying candle in the wind, yet carried an irresistible tenderness and expectation.

Chen Ji's eyes grew moist again, but his posture became even more upright like a pine. His mother's secret she protected with her life, his sister's freedom she bartered for... all these burdens now fell
